## Setup notes
1. Set your Google Sheets document (spreadsheet ID) on both Google Sheets nodes below.
2. Set your Telegram credential + chat ID (8988190596) on the Telegram node.
3. This workflow checks the Queue tab for a pending item, and only pings Telegram about an empty queue ONCE per exhaustion (no repeat spam).
4. Wire the 'Queue Has Item' TRUE branch into your actual render-trigger logic (POST /jobs/render on render_service.py).

Wire this branch onward to:
1. Mark the Queue row 'in_progress'
2. POST /jobs/render on render_service.py
(continue building Phase C from here)
